text:

Among 2 analysts covering Canadian Solar ( NASDAQ:CSIQ ), 0 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 1 Hold. Therefore 0 are positive. Canadian Solar Inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs, develops, makes, and sells solar ingots, wafers, cells, modules, and other solar power products primarily under the Canadian Solar brand name. The company has market cap of $869.35 million. The firm operates through two divisions, Module and Energy. It has a 4.88 P/E ratio. The Company’s products include various solar modules that are used in residential, commercial, and industrial solar power generation systems.
